retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel grid layout combining a primary artist portrait with secondary rustic textures and silhouette imagery for a modern country aesthetic.

recipe.visualDefinition: An asymmetrical grid composition featuring a large vertical portrait on the left and a stack of smaller, varied rectangular panels on the right, unified by a warm, desaturated color palette and bold slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary portrait occupies the left 60% of the frame
Right column consists of four stacked rectangular panels of varying heights
Horizontal text banners intersect the grid at the top and middle-right
Consistent warm, earthy color grading across all photographic elements
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat as a central thematic element
Heavy black grid lines separating the panels
Extended slab-serif typography with wide tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject is a medium shot of a man in a cowboy hat, positioned on the left, filling the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large portrait on the left serves as the primary anchor, balanced by the high-contrast silhouette in the bottom-right panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text banner, moves down the main portrait, then scans the right-hand grid from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with imagery and textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre, tan, and sepia tones in the background and texture panels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A single vibrant red panel in the lower-right grid for visual pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast; values range from deep shadows to bright, warm highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif with heavy rectangular serifs and uniform stroke weight.
letterConstructionRules: Consistent thickness between stems and bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different sizes and placements to maintain thematic consistency.
graphicDevices: Thick black borders between grid cells

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric construction.
Provides the classic country/western slab feel with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grid collage with a large vertical portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat on the left. On the right, stack four panels: a stone texture, a wooden staircase from a low angle, a solid red square, and a silhouette of a man in a cowboy hat. Use a warm, sepia-toned color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two horizontal banners with a gold-to-white gradient. Place uppercase, wide slab-serif text centered on these banners at the top and middle-right.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a wide slab serif?
Are the colors warm and desaturated?
Is there a distinct red panel in the grid?

mustRedesign: Do not use exact brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Verify the left portrait is the largest element
Check that the slab-serif text is uppercase and widely spaced
Ensure the grid lines are thick and black
Confirm the presence of rustic textures like wood or stone
recipe.reuseFormula: Asymmetrical Grid + Rustic Textures + Wide Slab Serif + Sepia Tones
